TITLE: Audio Reactivity Test Card
DESCRIPTION: Internal diagnostic test card -- NOT a shipped scene. An unambiguous, measurable audio-reactivity readout for judging capture-to-pixel latency and per-frame smoothness by eye: eight hue-ramped FFT spectrum bars (height = chroma_AudioFFT band), a left-edge RMS column with a bright chroma_AudioPeak tick, a central beat disc whose radius + brightness spike on low-end energy (the latency read), and 25/50/75% gridlines so bar heights are eyeball-measurable. The render path smooths these reactive values per-frame, so the card visualises the SMOOTHED signal. Numerically safe + finite at silence (near-black, flat bars, disc at base radius). Original clean-room authoring from standard public spectrum-analyzer / level-bar / VU technique; not registered in any library bundle.
